identity: Lethariel keeps the oldest trees in the Accord, and someone with a forged bough-seal is counting them for the axe.

quests.title: [PH] What the Seal Was For
quests.text: [PH] Eriath: Poacher Bough-Counter Rusk marks the old trees for the axe with an abused bough-seal at the poacher camp; stop him. Rusk alone stands for the false records. Real text to follow.
quests.completion: [PH] Eriath: the seal means tending again; Rusk's handwriting may yet turn up elsewhere. Real text to follow.
quests.lesson: The capital's named leader at his camp, alone: the capital's local finale.
quests.notes: Round 60 CAPITALS: a new id (its objectives changed); free play, a level only.
